notes: Attempt 3 of 3, and the best of the three. Attempt 1 already had the correct encircling split but left the cuff's overlapping end entirely white and the ratio uncertain. Attempt 2 was a clear REGRESSION - it split the cuff lengthwise (a seam running from the sleeve seam down to the hem) and used a near-white grey, losing both the geometry and the contrast. Attempt 3 restored the encircling split with a clearly visible navy upper half. Reading of the drawing: it is a 3/4 view of an isolated cuff drum whose axis runs left-right in the image, so the drawn vertical division line is a seam running AROUND the wrist and the drawn left/right halves are the sleeve-side (upper) and hand-side (lower) halves of the band. That reading is corroborated by the option labels ('upper portion'/'lower portion of sleeve cuff'), by the rounded cuff corner sitting in the hand-side half in both sibling drawings, and by the fact that a cuff spliced lengthwise is not a real construction.
